composers_checked.name: Romberg, Andreas
composers_checked.note: Floor from the MDG string-quartet discs (Vol. 2 track list on Apple Music; Vol. 1 from de.wikipedia, IMSLP comments and the BBC Music review), Naxos 8.554765 and MDG 603 1843-2 (flute quintets), and the Hyperion, Orfeo and Rodin discs (Clarinet Quintet Op. 57, the gap-check addition). Gap check against de.wikipedia's work list (SteR numbers): Op. 57 added; the Horn Trio (Andante con variazioni, SteR 165) and the early Quartet for violin, clarinet, bassoon and cello were not checked individually for recordings (Apple Music lookup was blocked).

composers_checked.name: Danzi, Franz
composers_checked.note: Floor from Apple Music track lists (MDG flute quartets and CPO flute quintets by the Ardinghello Ensemble; EigenArt and RBM string-quartet discs; CRD, ASV and Bongiovanni bassoon-quartet discs) and checked the Orfeo septet disc (a wind-septet version of Op. 15, so not counted). Gap check against the English and German Wikipedia work lists: added the three Bassoon Quartets Op. 40 (recorded, not on IMSLP); the Flute Trios Op. 71 (flute, violin, cello) and the 'Septet' Op. 10 (wind sextet arrangement) have no string chamber recording found. The wind quintets (Op. 56, 67, 68) have no string part.

note: Andreas Romberg, not his cousin Bernhard: the Ardinghello/CPO disc 555 598-2 (2026) with "Flute Quintet Op. 1 No. 3", Divertimento Op. 40 and Grand Trio Op. 8 is Bernhard's, and IMSLP's Op. 1 flute-quintet page mixes Andreas (Nos. 1-2) with Bernhard (No. 3); that page is skipped here and No. 3 belongs with Bernhard Romberg. Gap check additions: Andreas Romberg's Clarinet Quintet in E-flat, Op. 57 (imslpPage null; IMSLP holds only the string version, Op. 58, skipped because no recording of it was found) and Danzi's three Bassoon Quartets, Op. 40 (recorded on CRD, ASV, Bongiovanni and SWR; not on IMSLP). Opus numbers collide: Danzi's Op. 40 is both the Piano Quartet (skipped) and the Bassoon Quartets, and Op. 56 is both the wind quintets (no strings) and the flute quartets kept. Uncertain: Romberg Op. 21 No. 2 is skipped because an IMSLP page comment mentioning a 1991 Jecklin disc could not be confirmed; Danzi's Sextet Op. 15 (2 horns and strings) is skipped because the only recording found, Consortium Classicum's Orfeo disc, plays a version for wind septet (Apple Music track titles); Danzi Op. 6 No. 2 ("Figaro") is on the RBM disc as a first movement only. Romberg's Op. 41 date (c. 1811, IMSLP and Edition HH) conflicts with de.wikipedia (Leipzig 1816). Apple Music and MusicBrainz answered 403/503 for most of the later lookups, so "no recording found" for the unrecorded works rests on IMSLP, Wikipedia discographies, MusicBrainz and web searches plus the first Apple searches by composer and genre; durations of Romberg's flute quintets are blank for the same reason. Catalogue numbers: Danzi's P. numbers only where a recording's track list gives them (Op. 7 No. 1, Op. 55 No. 3); Romberg's SteR numbers are left out.
